summary: Targeted retest of the iteration_1 CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM fixes only (per request). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_retest_bridge.py — GET /api/bridge/suggestions now returns 4 unique non-empty strings for the fully-seeded owner (>=3 requirement met, fallbacks appended), and /api/dashboard/summary regression passes (2/2 pytest). Frontend (Playwright, owner login heatherprejean7325@gmail.com): (1) Bridge streaming fixed — sent 2 messages, zero doubled consecutive words in the streamed text; action pills = 3 per reply and each pill label/route is unique (no duplicate pills; previously 6 per reply). (2) Bridge markdown now clean — no '###' headings, no '**bold**' asterisks, no raw '- ' bullets; bullets correctly rendered as '• '. (3) Bridge suggestion chips render for the owner despite 6 existing history messages (4 chips before and after streaming, >=3 required). (4) Library CourseDetail — clicked lesson 'Practice: replay a hard call' in Decision-Making Framework, clicked complete-lesson-btn: button disappears and the active lesson pane immediately shows the green 'Completed' badge plus sidebar check, no reload needed. (5) Regression — owner email/password login works, dashboard renders 13 section cards + 16 sidebar nav items, deep section routes (/app/section/requirements, documents, independent-living, identity, health-hub, benefits-hub, home-hub, employment-record, employment-readiness, support-circle, life-skills) all render their own H1 and content, /app/library renders 8 course cards. No console errors other than the expected pre-login 401 from /api/auth/me.
action_items: No new issues from this retest. Remaining deferred (unchanged from iteration_1, explicitly out of scope this pass): window.prompt in Requirements.logPayment, native date/datetime inputs instead of shadcn Calendar, missing data-testid on dialog Save buttons + silent HTML5 validation leaving the modal overlay intercepting clicks, CORS wildcard + allow_credentials, untyped dict bodies in generic crud_endpoints, full-replace PUT semantics on emergency-profile/personal profile.
critical_code_review_comments: BridgeChat.jsx setMessages updater is now pure ({...last, content: last.content + chunk}) — StrictMode-safe. Note the catch() branch (lines 97-103) still mutates `last.content` in place for the error fallback; harmless today but make it immutable too for consistency.
Library.jsx load() correctly re-resolves `active` from the freshly loaded lessons; behaviour verified in the UI.

bridge_suggestions caps top-up at 4 items then slices to 6 — fine, but the fallback loop's `if len(suggestions) >= 4: break` means a fully-empty participant can hit 6 context suggestions with zero fallbacks; intended, no action.
parseActions() de-dupes by label|route — a reply that intentionally links the same route twice with different labels still yields two pills (correct).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested items (4/4 fixed issues verified) + login/dashboard/deep-page regression pass

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. One additional owner lesson was marked complete during the completion test (education now 3/22 lessons, 14%).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_1 CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM correctness bugs are fixed and verified.
